assessment: The proposed route is justified and uses existing instrumentation without a production repair. One actual completed selected-record read can bind the original review owner; Back can observe its closure separately from parent-held workspace lifetime. Fresh Files selection and normal recovery without omission test a useful distinct state transition. Three host-proof refinements below should precede freeze.

requiredBeforeFreeze.kind: verification gap, not observed runtime defect
requiredBeforeFreeze.finding: reader_released is recorded when the host sends release, without observing the released protocol or descriptor close at that boundary. Back later does check actual released/noncancelled/closed plus reviewOwnerClosed, which is sound but temporally later.
requiredBeforeFreeze.required: Name the early record releaseRequested, or observe and persist same nonce/file/ordinal released with descriptorCloseSucceeded true once the actual meal record has loaded or at the first genuine-failure attachment. Keep reviewOwnerClosed distinct and require it only after review Back. Do not infer owner closure merely from record-detail navigation.

requiredBeforeFreeze.finding: observed-2 and success branches inspect the current first protocol record, but do not explicitly compare its nonce, ordinal and stage with held[record], while released claims sameActualControl. The native tag and sole-attempt structure provide partial alignment; explicit binding makes this proof durable.
requiredBeforeFreeze.required: At observed-2 and success, require one attempt, ordinal2, nonce and stage equal held record, workerControlMatchesUI true and uiCancelled false; validate correct held/released phase before messages or success acknowledgement. Persist the observed record rather than only Boolean proof claims.

requiredBeforeFreeze.finding: Before success acknowledgement the host verifies installed records/photos, zero omissions and reviewed/photo digests, plus fresh source/provider identity. Receipt fileSource/source/domains/recordDigests are checked only after native Back, cleanup and relaunch.
requiredBeforeFreeze.required: Move or repeat complete receipt identity/domain/recordDigest assertions into the success-before-ack branch and persist those checked fields. Keep terminal checks too if they establish relaunch persistence. This preserves the intended source/provider/installed-record/full-receipt audit while the actual review remains open.

integrationRequirements: Apply selected-record launch flags only for RecoveryPhotoFaultErrorBack tests inside the recovery setup path, after existing arguments are assigned. Existing RecoveryPhotoFault setup already supplies actual cancel/success observer fixtures and normal/light configuration. Current182 intentionally lacks these new tests/flags.

Canonical placement is required before running the standalone driver: its base is __file__.parent and repo=base.parents[2], so the /tmp draft is not runnable in place. Freeze the final canonical driver/setup/tests with new source/build receipts; audit final diff and executable continuity.

First failure should remain before test scrolling. Control1 is made before payload validation and may fail before preparation; only actual preparation control2 should create the sole cancel checkpoint. Not now must leave no preparation checkpoint/stage/receipt. Preserve this assertion rather than manufacturing ordinal1 preparation.

Retain finite deadlines and raw failure evidence if host misses any attachment boundary. Three-second sleeps provide observation opportunities, not host acknowledgements or a proof of all schedules. Source179 already demonstrated why success needs an explicit acknowledgement.

advice.finding: Requiring a fresh selected file inode/device tuple to differ from the deleted old file can falsely reject legitimate inode reuse.
advice.recommendation: Use fresh UUID workspace owner and distinct new path, old workspace absence, regular nonlinked file and exact content/metadata binding as primary independence proof. Record inode continuity facts honestly; do not treat a reused inode after deletion alone as stale ownership.

advice.finding: The deliberate-scroll check samples the meal choice frame/value over three seconds with intervening native queries.
advice.recommendation: Credit only that bounded ordinary-scroll observation, not continuous observation, all choices remaining simultaneously visible, reveal-yield interleavings, VoiceOver or Reduce Motion.

validatedSourceAlignment: Native attachment prefixes and suffixes match host captured tags: source, record-held-1/record-observed-1, failed, scroll-stays, omission-not-now, back-parent, reselected-source, held-2/observed-2, success and parent.

Existing selected-record reader checkpoint uses held/released phases, acknowledgementOnly messages and separate descriptorCloseSucceeded/reviewOwnerClosed facts. Host lsof/file/inode/PID binding follows those actual fields. Existing first meal field0 is Meal and the declared first fixture is lunch.

BackupRecoveryReviewSession.close marks didEndReview for its verification source. Parent clearPreview closes the recovery owner when reviewingRecovery becomes false. Child record navigation is not itself review closure.

Back audit permits surviving unchanged parent-owned workspaces and explicitly disclaims host deletion. Fresh selection requires all old roots absent and independently owned healthy original photos. This correctly distinguishes owner closure from immediate total workspace deletion.

Preparation/success checks bind exact current/prior records, healthy water/conflicting goals, fresh distinct photo IDs and both JPEG digests. Receipt and relaunch scope remain two selected domains, not a full product check.
